description: This file defines a PHP class 'trello' that provides an API wrapper for Trello's REST API, including methods for retrieving issues, adding issues, adding notes, and fetching board and list details. It appears to be part of a library for interacting with Trello from PHP, specifically tailored to support certain project needs.

classes.name: trello
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with Trello's REST API, including retrieving cards, adding issues and comments, and fetching board and list details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Trello API wrapper with context parameters and optional configuration.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a Trello issue/card given its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific Trello card by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Trello card (issue) with a title and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment (note) to a specified Trello card.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Fetches details of the Trello board associated with the instance.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific list in Trello, with optional fields.
